story.fullStory:
Too Late's "Shoes" — original release 2006. "Shoes" is a song recorded by American actor Liam Kyle Sullivan, performing as his alter ego, Kelly.

Artist: Too Late · Title: Shoes · Album: Shoes - Too Late · Year: 1979 · Genre: Rock · Path: /Users/bobhopp/DJ MEDIA/VIDEO/1970's/Too Late - Shoes.mp4.

After Sullivan posted its music video to his own website in early 2006, he uploaded it to YouTube on May 5, 2006, where it became one of the first-ever viral videos online.

It was included on Kelly's debut studio album, also titled Shoes (2006).
